judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6 — before_validation only strips lowercase `http(s)://`; `HTTP://example.com` or `//example.com` become `HTTP:`/empty and fail with a confusing format error rather than being normalized.

record.issue_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:6 — before_validation only strips lowercase `http(s)://`; `HTTP://example.com` or `//example.com` become `HTTP:`/empty and fail with a confusing format error rather than being normalized.

adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the before_validation normalizer uses a case-sensitive regex `self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and then strips everything after the first slash with `self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`. For inputs like `HTTP://example.com`, the scheme isn’t removed, and the second substitution turns it into `HTTP:`. For `//example.com`, the second substitution strips to an empty string. Both then fail `validates_format_of :host` with a confusing error instead of being normalized to `example.com`.
